study_design: Prospective cohort analysis of men in the intervention arm of the Prostate, Lung, Colorectal and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: We analysed data from 25 097 men within the intervention arm of the 155 000 participant Prostate, Lung, Colorectal and Ovarian Cancer Screening Trial.
reason: The abstract analyzes histologically confirmed incident prostate cancer overall during follow-up. It does not report an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal incidence analysis.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Cox regression models were used to assess associations between tea intake and CaP incidence.
estimate_classifications.reason: The tea estimate concerns overall prostate cancer incidence. The stored estimate is the reciprocal of the abstract's reported HR and CI, but this inversion does not alter its general endpoint classification.
